messages:
deploy-bot: kicking off staged rollout v8.4.0 -> 5% us-west, 5% eu-central. change window 02:30-03:30 UTC
samira: quick check: p95 in eu-central nudged up ~60ms but tiny sample, posting a couple traces
leo: grabbing traces, seeing intermittent prompt-normalization failures in the trace snippets, looks like mismatch on punctuation trimming
sre-oncall: recommend we soft-hold eu-central and route to compat variant if possible, otherwise pin back. Keep us-west moving for now
samira: soft-route looks good; prefer lower blast radius. command suggestion: `redwoodctl route set --region eu-central --variant compat-8.3.9`
release-manager: from release perspective, if we route compat we should add a short release-note appendix about the canary reroute and note that full rollout is paused for eu-central only
leo: creating INF-10021 with trace ids and minimal repro. assigning to tokenization team
sre-oncall: plan: set compat route for eu-central, run 10m smoke (tokenizer + kv + latency tails). If green, keep soft-route and proceed to 10% in us-west; if fail, pin eu-central to v8.3.9 and escalate
infra: quick note: compat variants are already baked and small to flip, good to go
samira: executing soft-route via deploy-bot
```
redwoodctl route set --region eu-central --variant compat-8.3.9
```
deploy-bot: executing: `redwoodctl route set --region eu-central --variant compat-8.3.9`
deploy-bot: eu-central route set to compat-8.3.9 (op id: rx-9982) :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: starting eu-central smoke now (100 quick inferences + kv warmups). ETA ~7m
support: drafting a 1-line internal blurb: "EU canary routed to compat variant due to tokenizer edge-case; monitoring."
leo: smoke basic checks look clean so far; tail latency back to baseline under compat route
release-manager: decision: keep eu-central on compat route until tokenization patch lands; us-west can proceed to 10% under observation. schedule v8.4.1 with tokenizer fix for next window (~3h ETA)
sre-oncall: marking eu-central stop/go: SOFT-STOP (compat route active). us-west status: PROGRESS 10% OBSERVE
samira: operational note: to fully pin instead of route: `redwoodctl rollout pin --region eu-central --version v8.3.9 --reason "tokenizer edge-case"` and to resume original variant after fix: `redwoodctl route set --region eu-central --variant v8.4.0`
infra: will validate image tags and promote patch once PR merges
support: will hold off public comms unless patch ETA slips beyond 4h; internal support blurb ready to send
samira: will post final status here when PR merges and infra smoke passes. thanks team :thumbsup:
